intro: Looking for a lead generation company in London? Myntmore runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for B2B companies selling to London buyers, from UK firms to Indian companies winning UK clients and partners. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.
whyTitle: Why selling to London needs outbound

why.title: Europe's busiest B2B buying centre
why.desc: The City, Canary Wharf and Shoreditch hold banks, insurers, fintechs and the European headquarters of global firms. Their buyers are pitched constantly, so only specific, relevant outreach gets read.

why.title: Outreach has to follow the rules
why.desc: UK GDPR and PECR shape who you can email and how. Campaigns that respect them, with a clear sender and an easy opt-out, protect your domain and your reputation.

why.title: Partnerships, not just clients
why.desc: Many firms grow in the UK through partners: accounting practices, recruiters and distributors. Outreach can open those partner conversations as well as direct sales.

stepsTitle: How B2B lead generation works with us

steps.title: ICP and buying signals
steps.desc: We define who to target and which signals mean they are in-market: funding, new offices, hiring, leadership changes and regulatory deadlines.

steps.title: Lists, domains and copy
steps.desc: Verified contact lists, dedicated sending domains with warm-up, and copy written for UK buyers, in British English, with a clear sender and opt-out.

steps.title: Campaigns go live
steps.desc: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences start sending in UK business hours, with account-based plays for named enterprise accounts.

steps.title: Conversations, then consistency
steps.desc: First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we tune messaging on real replies.

stepsNote: Outreach rules for this market: UK GDPR allows B2B cold email on a legitimate interest basis when the message is relevant to the recipient's role. Under PECR, emails to corporate addresses don't need prior consent but must identify the sender and offer an opt-out.
